name: llm-surgeon
description: Surgery Engine for local LLM weights (SafeTensors, GGUF) exposed to Claude as the `surgeon mcp` server, with a skill that enforces a safe surgery workflow: check first, work on a copy, dry run before apply, keep the backup, measure before concluding.

allow_dir.title: Allowed directory
allow_dir.description: The only directory the surgeon MCP server may read and write (models, prompts, directions, patches). Put copies of your models there, never the originals.
